scope: Only active when body has desert-theme class or localStorage yamb_theme is desert.

packs.description: Only the active splash, background and optimized 384 px main-menu thumbnails load at startup. Transparent 256/384/512 px room assets hydrate on room entry; high-resolution masters remain preserved outside the shipped www tree.
Original sculpted desert background with dunes, wind-carved sand, sun and sandstone relief.

Transparent 1672x941 Desert Soft Clay title with two straight centered lines: warm sandstone YAMB OF THE and contrasting muted-turquoise BALKAN. It uses the same responsive slot, 4.5-second reveal, decoded-asset hold and reduced-motion behavior as Easter.

All room and game-mode entries now use the dedicated restrained Desert Soft Clay Relief 3D language. The four main game modes keep the proven Easter card dimensions, positions, title alignment and motion while using Desert-only assets without decorative backplates.

Five professional matte-clay icons for Daily Challenge, Leaderboard, Statistics, Settings and Rules. They use sandstone, cream, terracotta and muted turquoise without jewelry, gemstones, ornate gold or Easter motifs; their 44x44 slots, positions, click geometry and sequential 8.4-second wave motion exactly match the Easter Theme Pack.

Dedicated 4.6-second icon-only Desert Daily Challenge intro with a large softly pulsing room mark, plus room, task, already-played, completion, rewarded-video and Ducat Soft Clay assets. Runtime PNGs use normalized transparent margins, are optimized to 512 px and are prepared on room entry. Layout, spacing and visual dimensions match the proven Easter room parameters while all game logic remains shared and unchanged.

Dedicated 4.6-second icon-only Desert Top List intro with a large softly pulsing room mark, Desert header and Global/Local icons, empty/loading state, themed list contrast and one shared Desert gold/sand-silver/terracotta podium set with clear I, II and III relief marks. Runtime PNGs are optimized to 512 px and prepared on room entry; Waiting Top 3 uses the same podium and state system.

Dedicated 4.6-second icon-only Desert Statistics intro with a large softly pulsing room mark and no title; optimized 512 px Desert header, overview, record, games, result, average, trophies, ducats, All-Time PTS, H2H and empty-state Soft Clay assets with normalized visible silhouettes; six compact 128 px H2H-detail icons and the shared Desert VS mark; plus versioned lightning Power Index and flame Fire Streak gold/silver/bronze podium mini-packs with clear I, II and III relief marks. Power Index and Fire Streak both keep the player's rank in the fixed bottom dock used by Easter. Every active Statistics asset is prepared when the room opens.

Dedicated 4.6-second icon-only Desert Settings intro with a large softly pulsing room mark and no title; optimized 512 px v2 room/header, profile/account, sound, music, vibration, display/theme, language, terms and privacy Soft Clay assets are prepared on room entry. Switches, theme select, name field, Google account data, language flags, links and close control remain unchanged.

Dedicated 4.6-second icon-only Desert Global Chat intro with a large softly pulsing room mark and no title; optimized 512 px v2 standalone room/header, centered send and empty/loading Soft Clay assets are prepared on room entry. Close, character counter, online indicator, report control, message layout and chat logic remain unchanged.

Dedicated 4.6-second icon-only Desert Online Players intro with a large softly pulsing room mark and no title; normalized 512 px v2 room/header, Add Friend and Watch Match assets plus the existing 512 px Duel and empty/loading marks are prepared on room entry. The main-menu room mark uses the same calm signal motion and reduced-motion fallback as Easter. Muted unavailable variants, infinite progressive player list, name search filter, status colors, avatars, player data and close control remain unchanged.

Dedicated restrained matte-clay Desert YotB QL Pack: a transparent geometric room emblem with four straight diamond edges, used consistently in the 4.6-second intro, main-menu watermark, room header, compact Liga tab, Rules and quarter-winner state; standalone Hall of Fame, Medals and Champions tab icons without ornamental backplates; six standardized rank badges from Amateur through Titan plus All Time; and a matching gold, silver and bronze clay podium set used in rankings, Hall of Fame and quarter-end notifications. Purple Easter wave colors, jewels, crowns, laurels, glossy gold and inherited dark tab/pagination bands are excluded.

Dedicated 4.6-second icon-only Desert Dukati / Ispravi zadnji upis intro with a large softly pulsing room mark and no title. The normalized, transparent 512 px room, ducat, undo-token, rewarded-video and unavailable-ad assets are prepared on room entry and cache-versioned. The active tab switches the room-header icon; balance, +500, Vaši tokeni and +1 use the same pack; unavailable rewards keep a readable warm-sand surface instead of the global gray/hourglass state. The main-menu room mark uses the same calm sway and reduced-motion fallback as Easter.

Dedicated Desert Soft Clay main-menu and final-score marks plus a restrained personal-best badge. Solo keeps direct entry without an additional room intro and preserves the board, dice skin, scoring, controls, resume/new-game behavior and dimensions.

Dedicated Desert two-player Soft Clay mark, standard 4.6-second room intro and winner result mark. Both boards, manual swipe, automatic active-player tracking, turn status, controls, results and all dimensions remain shared and unchanged.

Dedicated Desert globe/search pack for main menu, 4.6-second intro, waiting header, scanning, found-opponent, spectating, disconnect and reconnect states. Player cards, full names, Power/POB/NER/POR layout, connection status colors, dual-board swipe and automatic turn tracking remain unchanged, while the working online duel countdown uses the same fixed-width pill geometry as the spectator LIVE badge in Desert colors.

Dedicated Desert invite pack for main menu, 4.6-second intro, room header, add, send, sent, accepted and empty states. Owner/top-rival and friend-card geometry matches Easter while using Desert surfaces; avatars, full names, statistics, room code, safe-zone spacing and invitation logic remain unchanged.

Dedicated 4.6-second icon-only Desert Treasury intro with a large softly pulsing chest and no title; calm reduced-motion-aware main-menu chest motion; header, Trofeji/Skinovi/Efekti/Teme tabs, owned/active/locked/insufficient states and collection marks; plus 26 transparent 384 px Desert Soft Clay trophy PNGs mapped one-to-one to the shared trophy IDs, conditions and rewards. The same individual images and Desert Ducat are used in unlock notifications and the final trophy showcase. Every active Treasury asset is prepared on room entry; buying, equipping, ads, dice skins, effects and theme previews remain shared and unchanged.

True Soft Clay Relief 3D Desert Tournament Pack: calm victory-sway main-menu trophy, 4.6-second icon-only intro with a pulsing large trophy and fixed live Top 3 card using its numbered I/II/III Desert podium medals, matching Info/Bracket/Hall of Fame tabs, registration and match states, responsive two-column Hall of Fame champion cards that preserve full long names and every action, plain silver finalist badge and a fully Desert-styled final ceremony. Every active Tournament asset is prepared on room entry. No flat vector substitutes, jewels, ornate frames, crowns, laurels or Easter-style decoration.

Desert-only Rules identity matching the Easter implementation pattern: 4.6-second room intro, header icon, six dedicated page/title assets under desert-soft-clay/rules/pages, compact inline room/action/state icons, Desert QL reward podium medals and all referenced Desert assets for Online Players, Global Chat, Add Friend, Spectate, Duel, H2H, Fire Streak, All-Time PTS, Treasury tabs, Economy icons, rewarded video and connection states. Rule text, numbering, lists, swipe, pagination dots, close control and functional dice illustrations remain unchanged; other themes keep their own icon layers.
Sandstone-and-glass board, dice, score cells, HUD and controls without changing board dimensions.
Cards, typography, inputs, modals, notifications, chat, treasury, stats, rules and leaderboard contrast.
Splash, quote, waiting and game-over screens with the same desert visual language.
Soft dune-rise, glass-glint, hover and waiting motion with reduced-motion fallback.
Desert-styled loading, empty and fallback states.
Procedural warm desert-glass cues for click, roll, score, announce, win, error and trophy.
Final screenshot set: splash, quote, main menu, board, leaderboard, settings, stats, treasury, chat, waiting and game-over.

designTokens.shapeLanguage: rounded glass badges, pills and inset sandstone surfaces
designTokens.shadowLanguage: soft raised and inset desert neumorphism

rules: Do not change global theme icons as the base game style.
Keep all Desert Glass styling isolated under body.desert-theme.

The splash title uses the same transparent PNG slot, responsive dimensions, 4.5-second reveal timing, decoded-asset hold and reduced-motion fallback as Easter; both text rows remain straight, while BALKAN uses a contrasting muted Desert turquoise.

The bottom room row from Daily Challenge through Rules uses clean standalone 44x44 Soft Clay Relief icons with the same layout and dimensions as Easter, but a restrained sandstone/terracotta/turquoise palette and no decorative backplates or kitsch ornament.

The five Desert bottom-room icons use the same staggered 8.4-second wave as Easter: only the visible icon moves, while button positions and click targets remain fixed; reduced-motion disables the animation.
Daily Challenge uses the same 4.6-second icon-only intro duration, large-icon dimensions and calm pulse as Easter, but only the Desert room mark, colors and background; no intro title is rendered.
Inside Daily Challenge, use the Desert room, task, already-played, completion and rewarded-video icons without changing dice, scoring, timer, reward amount or functional controls.
Top List uses the same 4.6-second icon-only intro duration, large-icon dimensions and calm pulse as Easter, but only the Desert leaderboard mark, background and palette; no intro title is rendered.
Inside Top List, use Desert Global, Local and empty/loading assets while keeping week/month/all-time filters textual and preserving avatars, names, scores, ordering and data-source logic.

Use the same Desert v4 leaderboard podium medals with built-in I, II and III relief marks for the first three places in both the Top List and Waiting Top 3; do not overlay duplicate Arabic rank-number bubbles.
Statistics uses the same 4.6-second icon-only intro duration, large-icon dimensions and calm pulse as Easter, but only the Desert Statistics mark, background and palette; no intro title is rendered.

Inside Statistics, use the optimized Desert Soft Clay category, H2H, H2H-detail and VS assets prepared on room entry, plus dedicated lightning Power Index and flame Fire Streak podium sets with built-in I, II and III relief marks; Power Index and Fire Streak use the same fixed bottom 'Moje mesto' dock geometry and behavior as Easter, while graphs, progress bars, values, POB/NER/POR semantic colors, swipe behavior, card dimensions, pagination and ranking logic remain unchanged.
Settings uses the same 4.6-second icon-only intro duration, large-icon dimensions and calm pulse as Easter, but only the Desert Settings mark, background and palette; no intro title is rendered.

Inside Settings, use the optimized 512 px Desert v2 Soft Clay icons prepared on room entry for profile/account, sound, music, vibration, display/theme, language, terms and privacy while preserving SRB/ENG flags, switches, theme select, name input, Google account data, links, close control and shared layout dimensions.

Global Chat uses the same 4.6-second icon-only intro duration, large-icon dimensions and calm pulse as Easter, but only the Desert room mark, background and palette; no intro title is rendered. Its clean standalone 44px main-menu icon has no rear bubble or decorative backplate and remains aligned to the Online Players card edge.

Inside Global Chat, use Desert Soft Clay header, send and empty/loading icons while preserving close, character counter, online indicator and status dot, report control, avatars, message layout and chat logic.

Online Players uses the same 4.6-second icon-only intro duration, large-icon dimensions and calm pulse as Easter, but only the Desert room mark, background and palette; no intro title is rendered. Its main-menu mark keeps Easter's signal-motion timing with a reduced-motion fallback.

Inside Online Players, keep the Easter search-filter position and dimensions, progressively render the complete live player list, fit long full names without changing avatar/action slots, and use Desert Soft Clay Add Friend, Watch Match, Challenge to Duel and empty/loading assets while preserving semantic player status colors and all socket actions.

Quarterly League uses the same 4.6-second intro duration, YotB QL logo dimensions, title spacing and wave as Easter, with one transparent straight-edged geometric Desert diamond used consistently as the intro mark, main-menu watermark, room header, Rules icon and quarter-winner mark.

Inside Quarterly League, reuse the straight-edged Desert YotB QL room emblem in the compact Liga tab exactly as Easter reuses its room emblem; use dedicated Desert Hall of Fame, Medals and Champions icons, persistent Amateur, Pro, Master, Legend, Titan and All Time badges, and the Desert QL podium medals while preserving real progress, points, rank names, avatars, pagination dots, swipe, infinite progressive lists and reward logic.

Dukati / Ispravi zadnji upis uses the same 4.6-second icon-only intro duration, large-icon dimensions and calm pulse as Easter, but only the Desert room mark, background and palette; no intro title is rendered. Its main-menu mark uses the same calm sway timing and reduced-motion fallback as Easter.

Inside the economy room, switch the Desert ducat/token header icon with the active tab and use the same Desert assets for balance, +500, Vaši tokeni, +1, rewarded video and unavailable-ad states; disabled rewards must use a readable warm-sand surface and the Desert unavailable-ad icon, never the global gray card or hourglass/ornamental fallback. Preserve counts, prices, ad availability, text, + quantities, close control and undo logic.

Solo, Two Players Hotseat, Find Opponent and Invite Friend use the exact proven Easter card dimensions, positions, icon slots, centered-title rows and resume/new-game geometry, with Desert-only matte Soft Clay assets and no decorative icon backplates.
Solo keeps direct entry without a new room intro. Hotseat, Find Opponent and Invite Friend use the shared 4.6-second large-icon intro with the same title spacing and wave timing as Easter.

Hotseat, online duels and spectating preserve manual swipe between both boards and automatic following of the active player; theme styling must never replace, disable or intercept that shared behavior.

Find Opponent preserves player cards, full-name fitting, Power/POB/NER/POR data, connection colors, timer and X control while using Desert scanning, found, spectating, disconnected and reconnected marks.
Invite Friend preserves owner, greatest-rival and friend-card data, room code, safe-zone spacing and invitation logic while using Desert add, send, sent, accepted and empty-state marks.
Riznica uses the same 4.6-second icon-only intro duration, large-icon dimensions and calm pulse as Easter, but only the Desert chest, background and palette; no intro title is rendered.

Inside Riznica, use the restrained matte-clay Desert header, Trofeji/Skinovi/Efekti/Teme tabs, owned/active/locked/insufficient states, neutral bronze/silver/gold collection marks and the dedicated 26-image Desert trophy pack. Use each trophy's matching Desert PNG and the Desert Ducat in unlock notifications and the final trophy showcase. Keep trophy IDs, requirements and rewards one-to-one with the shared data, and preserve rewarded-video/Ducat assets, actual dice skins, theme/effect previews, prices, buying and equipping logic.

Turnir uses the same 4.6-second icon-only intro duration, pulsing large-icon dimensions and real server-provided Top 3 card as Easter. Its first three rows use the matching numbered Desert I, II and III podium PNGs. The Top 3 card stays anchored 2 mm above the bottom safe zone and does not push the large icon downward; the icon language is restrained Desert matte clay without jewelry or ornamental Easter styling, and the 62px main-menu icon has no card or inner backplate and keeps the same calm victory-sway timing with a reduced-motion fallback.

Inside Turnir, use simplified Desert Info, Bracket and Hall of Fame tabs; register, unregister/refund, locked registration, start, active-match and completed-match states; clear numbered gold/silver/bronze podium medals only for the live all-time Top 3 shown during the intro; and the current clean Desert champion trophy in the result, Put do titule card and final ceremony, with the plain silver finalist badge for the runner-up. Preserve the bracket and lines, quarterfinal/semifinal/final layout, avatars, names, scores, match times, reward logic, six-second ceremony hold and phase swipe.

Rules uses Desert-only Soft Clay header, page/title, room, action, state and QL podium assets through the same isolated layer as Easter, including the same 4.6-second large-icon intro with the Desert rules mark. Old SVG/emoji symbols are hidden only under body.desert-theme, while text, numbering, lists, swipe, pagination dots, close control and functional dice illustrations remain unchanged.

Every active two-player online match in Desert uses the same fixed-width pill geometry as the spectator LIVE badge for its working turn countdown, but rendered with Desert danger/cream colors. My-turn, opponent-turn and urgent states keep identical dimensions; urgent pulse and countdown logic remain unchanged, while reconnection messages retain their wider dedicated layout.
Do not change game board/card dimensions or layout unless explicitly requested.
Desert background is separate from translucent glass treatments used only on UI elements.
Keep contrast readable on all light sand and glass surfaces.
Load only the active Desert splash, background and optimized main-menu thumbnails at startup; hydrate room assets on entry and never download hidden Easter, Green or Severna image variants.
